title: Saved examples
brief: Saved examples of a request (v1-features S4): save the current response as an example from the response pane, list a request's examples, open one read-only (request as written and response as saved, secrets masked), rename and delete; plus Save response body to file through the native dialog with a toast. Built on the bolt-v2 shell with a states desk.

artboards.title: Tree children, read-only example tab
artboards.tradeoff: Examples are visible and openable from the tree like any entity, and an example gets a whole tab; the tree grows a third row kind and gets longer, and comparing an example with the live response means switching tabs

artboards.title: An Examples tab in the request
artboards.tradeoff: The tree stays requests only and examples sit beside the request they document, saved inline without a dialog; they are invisible until the request is open, and the read-only view gets only the request pane's space while the live response collapses
